# Environment asset credits

All models in this folder come from free packs released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain).
Attribution isn't required, but credit is given gladly.

| Pack | Author | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Castle Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | First Harbour: towers, siege engines, banners, trees, shore rocks |
| Nature Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Wretch isle forest; stand-in themes on five isles awaiting Quaternius packs |
| Pirate Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Smuggler's cove: palms, huts, watchtower, cargo, wreck |
| Watercraft Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Boats, ships and buoys along the ocean route |
| Modular Cave Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Rock arches and walls around the rim settlement |
| Modular Dungeon Kit | Kenney (kenney.nl) | Ruined walls and gates in the Drowned Colossus arena |

Generated by `npm run build-env` from the packs downloaded by `npm run fetch-assets`.
